fact: The December 2025 version of the ministry's monthly activity report for health centres (headed MSPP/SE/SG/DGRP/DPSIS) is a 27-page paper form on which the health centre records the date it was drawn up, the date sent, the date of arrival at the district and the date of encoding.
title: Rapport mensuel d'activités – Centre de santé (version décembre 2025)
publisher: Ministère de la Santé Publique et de la Prévention, DPSIS (République du Tchad)
why_not: withdrawn by the parent, 2026-10-06: a blank reporting form, five pages of 27; its fields imply district entry but it states no dated fact
